name: Element x Bud Hub | 1g Live Resin Joint | Gorilla Glue #4 x Strawnana x Lemon OG
description: 50% Element Live Resin, 50% top-shelf flower, the Element Live Resin Joint is certified 100% fire. This award-winning infused pre-roll adds the power of Element Live Resin to premium flower, resulting in a naturally terpene rich joint with THC percentages commonly 45% or above.
